title: NotesLoomCastKitTypedDragEmbedBacklinkAndNavigation
clause: Deliver typed drag, embed, backlink, graph, search and navigation workflows between real Notes/Loom and CKC entities.

current_source_discovery: Inspect accepted Notes link/embed commands, Loom graph/view contracts and real CKC projection adapters.
Map every drag payload, drop target, navigation target and backlink type to a typed stable identity before editing.
stop_conditions: A drag payload relies on raw paths, UI labels or synthetic record types.
A workflow cannot identify the canonical owning surface for edits.

scope.summary: Turn connectivity into practical operator workflows: drag a real CKC character, sheet version, moodboard, image, album or folder into Notes/Loom; preserve typed identity; navigate and backlink to the owning source; reuse it in graphs and collection views.
forbidden_paths: Text/plain or path-only drag payload as authority
Embed that becomes an independent mutable CKC copy
Navigation that guesses module by string labels
acceptance_criteria: Typed drag payloads identify project, source domain, canonical record, projection version, relation intent and authorized brokered asset handles; forged/stale payloads fail closed.
Dropping CKC entities into Notes, Loom canvas or collection views creates idempotent typed relations/embeds and preserves canonical ownership without copying mutable domain state.
Backlinks from CKC to Notes/Loom and from Notes/Loom to CKC are queryable, source-attributed and navigate to the canonical owning surface/version.
Graph/search/view results expose real CKC entity type, projection status, provenance and open-in-owner action under correct scope.
Native cross-surface drag/drop, keyboard alternative, undo/retry, conflict, broken-source and revoked-source flows pass Argus and accessibility proof.
proof_targets: Run real-Surreal drag/embed/link/backlink/navigation E2E using actual CKC and RichDocument records.
Run forged, stale, duplicate, deleted, moved-version, cross-project and revoked payload negative tests.
Run Argus drag/drop plus keyboard-equivalent workflows and verify independent Surreal reread.

target_entries: CastKit > Drag and link to Notes/Loom

same_project_private_resource_cases: Private CKC entities cannot be dragged into another member's note without explicit compatible access.
cross_account_negative_cases: Forged, replayed or cross-account payloads fail without metadata disclosure.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Embed, preview, backlink and view item scope is the intersection of source and destination.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Revoked or stale payloads/embeds fail closed and visible UI revalidates.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Remote drag/source identifiers require explicit local mapping and grants.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Preview, source label, owner surface, version, backlink count and error class do not leak denied entities.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: drag, verify, link, embed, undo, navigate, deny and revoke events
payload compatibility, projection, relation and navigation health
cross-surface UI crash/freeze and recovery correlation

risk_if_missed: The database graph exists but operators cannot practically connect real creative resources to notes, views and downstream project work.

risks: Drag payload trusts UI text or raw path.
Navigation opens projection instead of domain source.

research_provenance.selected_approach: Typed versioned drag/embed payloads that create idempotent Surreal relations and navigate to canonical owners.
